q: There ___ a large number of _____ playing in the field.
Choose the correct sentence-
o: Many a students were present at the conference yesterday.
Many a students was present at the conference yesterday.
Many a student is present at the conference yesterday.
Many a student was present at the conference yesterday.
e: Many a/an-এর পরে singular countable noun এবং singular verb বসে। গঠন: Many a/an + singular noun + singular verb। এখানে Many a-এর পরে student singular, আর অতীত কাল বলে verb was হবে। Many a students বা were-সহ বাক্যগুলোতে plural ব্যবহার হওয়ায় ভুল, আর is present ... yesterday কালের সঙ্গে মেলে না।

q: (a) Neither the teacher (b) nor the students (c) was aware of the schedule change . (d) No error.
e: Neither ... nor দিয়ে দুটি subject যুক্ত হলে verb শেষ subject-এর সঙ্গে মেলে। এখানে শেষ subject the students বহুবচন, তাই verb হবে were, was নয়। ভুল c অংশে। শুদ্ধ বাক্য: Neither the teacher nor the students were aware of the schedule change। দুটি subject-ই একবচন হলে verb একবচন হয়, যেমন Neither he nor his brother is present। আবার বচন আলাদা হলে বহুবচন subject-টি verb-এর কাছে রাখা ভালো।

Choose the correct one.
o: A number of employees has resigned from the company.
A number of employee have resigned from the company.
A number of employees have resigned from the company.
A number of employee has resigned from the company.

q: Find the part that has an error: The athlete’s movements was restrained fluid and seemingly effortless to the viewer.
e: বাক্যের subject 'movements' বহুবচন, তাই verb-ও বহুবচন হবে: 'were'। 'was' singular subject-এর সঙ্গে বসে, ফলে এখানে ভুল। বাক্যের অর্থ 'খেলোয়াড়ের নড়াচড়াগুলো সংযত, তরল ও দেখে মনে হতো অনায়াস'। সঠিক বাক্য: The athlete's movements were restrained, fluid and seemingly effortless to the viewer. সূত্র: subject-এর শেষ শব্দ s-যুক্ত plural হলে (possessive athlete's ছাড়া) verb-ও plural হয়।

q: He along with his friends ____ going to the fair.
Now-a-days one of the major _____ road accident.
Choose the correct sentence:
o: The doctor, along with the nurses, are working hard during the night shift.
The doctor, along with the nurses, were working hard during the night shift.
The doctor, along with the nurses, have worked hard during the night shift.

q: Choose the sentence that misuses the determiner.
o: We have plenty of reasons to be proud.
I need some information before making a decision.
There is little chance of winning the game.
He gave much informations during the meeting.
e: Information অগণনীয় noun, তাই এর শেষে s বসিয়ে বহুবচন করা যায় না, আর much অগণনীয় noun-এর সঙ্গেই চলে। সুতরাং He gave much informations ভুল; শুদ্ধ রূপ He gave much information। সংখ্যা বোঝাতে হলে two pieces of information লিখতে হয়। অন্য বাক্যগুলো ঠিক: plenty of reasons ও some information সঠিক, আর little chance অগণনীয় noun-এর সঙ্গে ঠিক বসেছে।

q: He is one of the boys who ____ not written the letter given as homework.
One of my friends ___ coming to visit me tomorrow.
e:
'One of' গঠনের পরে বহুবচন noun থাকলেও Subject হলো one। এক জনের কথাই বলা হচ্ছে, তাই Verb singular হয়। সুতরাং 'is coming' ঠিক।
মনে রাখুন:
One of the boys is absent.
Each of the girls has a book.
Every one of them was present.
Subject-এর কাছের বহুবচন noun দেখে ভুল করা চলবে না।

q: Not only the chief but also all the subordinate officers _____ concerned about the matter.
Fill in the gap with appropriate word- "Many a man _____ tried but few have succeeded."
e: Many a বাক্যাংশের অর্থ অনেক হলেও এর পরে একবচন countable noun এবং singular verb বসে। গঠন: Many a + singular noun + singular verb। তাই Many a man has tried but few have succeeded শুদ্ধ। শেষের few have succeeded অংশে few বহুবচনবাচক বলে have বসেছে। have, are বা is এখানে মানায় না।

q: Choose the correct sentence-
o: One of the student is absent from school today.
One of the students is absent from school today.
One of the students are absent from school today.
One of the students were absent from school today.

q: ________ the truth.
e: The + adjective গঠনটি একটি পুরো শ্রেণিকে বোঝায় এবং বহুবচন noun-এর মতো আচরণ করে। তাই The honest-এর পরে plural verb speak বসে এবং adjective-এর সঙ্গে s/es যুক্ত হয় না। সুতরাং The honest always speak the truth। Honests ভুল, কারণ adjective-এর বহুবচন হয় না; আর always speaks ভুল, কারণ কর্তা বহুবচন।
